translations.web: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
translations.bsb: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
translations.kjv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.
